scope: Six difficult catalog identities delegated for a bounded recheck. No other registry or shared source edited.

rows.picturedModel: GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX revision 1.2, original owner photograph
rows.identityEvidence: Owner listing explicitly names B650 AORUS ELITE AX Rev 1.2 and links this specific board photo album. Actual model marking and original board layout visually confirmed. Same-album Device Manager photograph shows Realtek 8852CE WiFi 6E PCI-E NIC, matching revision 1.2 in the GIGABYTE official manual, printed page 8; earlier revisions specify AMD RZ616 or Intel AX210. The test photograph also shows CPU-Z model B650 AORUS ELITE AX and BIOS FB3g. The last physical PCB revision digit is obscured by a connector; no claim is made that it was visually read. Identity relies on the primary owner listing plus coherent actual-board testing evidence, rather than retailer stock photography.

rows.reason: No verified Crucial Pro Overclocking 64GB (2x32GB) DDR5-6000 CL36 SKU established. CL36 retailer search titles resolve to CP2K32G60C40U5W/B; the exact C40 product specifications identify CL40. A 32GB CL36 kit or 64GB CL40 kit cannot be relabeled as this catalog entry.
rows.requiredIdentity: A manufacturer part number proving 64GB (2x32GB), DDR5-6000 and factory-rated CL36, or an explicit catalog correction to the intended real product.

sources.finding: Search/page title says CL36, but actual product is CP2K32G60C40U5W. Main specification panel says CL40; detailed timing is 40-40-40-80, 64GB as two 32GB white modules. The apparent exact title is contradicted by its own product specifications.
Retail page labels CL36, while SKU is CP2K32G60C40U5W and remaining timing fields are 40-40-80. This inconsistent retailer record is not sufficient evidence of a separate CL36 SKU.
Distributor names CP2K32G60C40U5B as Crucial Pro OC 64GB (2x32GB), DDR5-6000 CL40 Black.
Actual title and specification table identify CP2K32G60C40U5B, 64GB DDR5-6000 CL40; family selector also offers other timings, which do not establish all capacity/timing combinations.

rejectedEvidence: Best Buy generated Q&A explicitly says it is AI-generated; not used as manufacturer confirmation.
Previously attempted guessed Crucial product URLs returned request-rejection bodies despite HTTP200; no repeats.

rows.reason: No exact 96GB (2x48GB) DDR5-6000 CL34 T-Create Expert SKU established. Manufacturer matrix assigns 96GB 6000 to CL30 and 96GB 6400 to CL32; 6000 CL34 is a different 64GB capacity. Family images and combined search selectors do not prove the catalog combination.
rows.requiredIdentity: An exact manufacturer SKU proving 96GB DDR5-6000 CL34, or an explicit catalog correction to the intended documented kit.

sources.finding: Official matrix lists 96GB (2x48GB) 6000MHz CL30 as CTCED596G6000HC30DDC01, 96GB 6400MHz CL32 as CTCED596G6400HC32BDC01 / ADC01, and 96GB 6800MHz CL36 as CTCED596G6800HC36DDC01. The 64GB (2x32GB) 6000MHz CL34 entry is CTCED564G6000HC34BDC01.
Exact CL34 6000 product is 64GB (2x32GB), CTCED564G6000HC34BDC01. A nearby 96GB family selector is not the selected product capacity.

rejectedEvidence: No results establish the hypothesized CTCED596G6000HC34 or white CTCWD596G6000HC34 identities; neither was invented or assigned a photo.

rows.catalogName: Cooler Master V Gold i Multi 1050
rows.reason: No V Gold i Multi 1050W product identity established. Manufacturer/distributor publications identify V750 and V850 Gold i Multi. Official wattage guide lists 1050W MWE Gold V2 / GX Gold separately; those are different product series.
rows.requiredIdentity: An exact Cooler Master model/part number proving V Gold i Multi 1050W, or a correction naming the intended real PSU.

sources.finding: Manufacturer identifies V850 Gold i multi, a fully modular ATX3.0 digital 80 PLUS Gold PSU.
Japanese distributor explicitly lists the series as two models, 750W and 850W, with part numbers MPZ-7501-AFAG-BJP and MPZ-8501-AFAG-BJP. No 1050W model appears in its series table.
Manufacturer guide names V Gold i 750 / 850 separately from MWE Gold V2 1050 and GX Gold 1050. A 1050W photo from those series would be a different product.

rejectedEvidence: MWE Gold V2 1050 and GX Gold 1050 photographs withheld because neither is V Gold i Multi.

rows.reason: No exact chassis SKU is present. The catalog states eight expansion slots and eight 3.5-inch plus two 2.5-inch bays. Plausible 4U workstation families differ: SC745 has seven full-height expansion slots, while SC747 has eleven. Matching the broad name or eight hot-swap drive bays does not identify a unique model or validate the eight-slot specification.
rows.requiredIdentity: Exact CSE/SC chassis part number and backplane/power/drive configuration, or an explicit correction to a documented real chassis.

sources.finding: SC745BAC-R1K23B-SQ supports E-ATX/ATX/Micro-ATX and eight 3.5/2.5-inch hot-swap drive bays, but seven full-height/full-length expansion slots, plus three 5.25-inch bays.
SC745 family system-feature table specifies seven PCIe full-height slots and up to eight 2.5/3.5-inch hot-swap bays.
SC747 server/workstation chassis manual specifies eleven full-height/full-length PCIe slots and eight hot-swappable hard-drive bays. This is also not the catalog eight-slot configuration.

rejectedEvidence: No SC745 or SC747 family photo substituted for the underspecified generic record.

rows.reason: Catalog identifies only manufacturer, 1600W and redundancy. Multiple physically different Supermicro part numbers satisfy those facts, so no unique pictured model can be established.
rows.requiredIdentity: Supermicro PWS part number, matching host system/chassis or another distinguishing electrical/mechanical specification.

sources.finding: Official 1600W redundant list includes PWS-1K63A-1R (Titanium), PWS-1K69P-1R (Platinum), and PWS-1K60D-1R (-48V DC input). All match the generic wattage/redundancy words but are distinct products.
PWS-1K69P-1R is a 1600W / 1000W 1U redundant Platinum module, 73.5×185×40mm, with gold-finger output.
Official FAQ identifies a further distinct PWS-1K68A-1R 1600W redundant module for SYS-621C-TN12R.
PWS-1K67P-1R is another 1600W redundant module with different 106.5×241.3×84mm dimensions. Wattage alone cannot select the physical photo.

rejectedEvidence: No arbitrary 1600W module was promoted to an exact image for the generic record.
